newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 10 discount T-bill issues this wee.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 10 discount T-bill issues this wee.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will offer 10 issues of discount T-bills with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance at auctions this week, the central bank said.
Half of the issues have a maturity of one week and the rest have a four-week maturity. Auction dates and issue dates for each issue overlap.
ISSUE NUMBER ISSUE DATE MATURITY DATE

The ministry has issued short-term treasury bills each day since January 20 to drain excessive banks' liquidity in line with preparations for the introduction of a restrictive fixed exchange rate regime, the currency board system.
As a result of the ministry's decision the central bank has suspended its daily open market operations through the revrepo facility with repurchase of over two days.

The decisions were related to preparing the banking system for the introduction of a currency board system proposed by the International Monetary Fund under which central bank open market operations would be curbed.
